feature: Work follow-up submission while a run is active
problem: the composer placeholder said follow-up input would queue, but the only button while running was Stop, so users could not submit the follow-up at all
fix: show Send and Stop simultaneously while a Work run is active
Send submits a follow-up turn to the same persistent conversation
the unified runtime serializes the new run behind the active run in the same conversation
Stop remains independently available for the active task
legacy tasks retain the local queue path
uiCases: both Send and Stop controls remain enabled while an act run is executing
a follow-up submitted during a slow run persists as a queued run
the queued follow-up executes after the active run completes
both runs finish successfully through the unified runtime
